messages.text: Humphries to face Price in World Grand Prix final in 2023 repeat

metadata.summary: Gerwyn Price and Luke Humphries will look for their second World Grand Prix titles when they meet in Sunday's final of the double-start event in Leicester.
metadata.content: World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries to face Gerywn Price in Sunday's final in Leicester, live on Sky Sports | Darts News | Sky Sports Skip to main content World Grand Prix Darts: Luke Humphries to face Gerywn Price in Sunday's final in Leicester, live on Sky Sports Luke Humphries reaches fourth straight World Grand Prix final after beating two-time champion James Wade in semis; Gerwyn Price defeats Nathan Aspinall as he targets first major title since 2022; watch live on Sky Sports+ and Sky Sports Main Event from 8pm Sunday Sunday 4 October 2026 01:38, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Luke Humphries was delighted to make a record-breaking fourth consecutive World Grand Prix final after playing 'consistent' darts against James Wade Gerwyn Price and Luke Humphries will look for their second World Grand Prix titles when they meet in Sunday's final of the double-start event in Leicester. Price, the 2020 champion, beat Nathan Aspinall 5-2 in Saturday's first semi-final before 2023 winner Luke Humphries defeated James Wade 5-3 to reach his fourth straight final and set up a repeat of the showpiece game three years ago - when he saw off Price 5-2. A major drought will end either way at the Mattioli Arena, with Humphries going over a year since his last premier title - the 2025 Premier League - and Price's previous elite silverware coming way back in 2022 at the World Series of Darts Finals in Amsterdam. metadata.summary: "We will always have a scar, we will always feel pain and disappointment. But this is the way to move forward."

But this is the way to move forward." Thomas Tuchel knows England's frustrating, much-criticised semi-final defeat to Argentina at the World Cup will hang over him and his team right through until the Euros in 2028 - and even beyond. But in Croatia on Saturday, a thumping 7-0 win was a performance and result to reinvigorate Tuchel's England project. It was a historic scoreline: Croatia's heaviest defeat. No team had scored more than four goals away to them before. messages.text: Rees-Zammit scores two tries as Bristol beat champions Northampton

metadata.summary: Wales wing Louis Rees-Zammit played a starring role as Bristol posted an early-season statement win by beating Gallagher Prem champions Northampton 41-26 at Ashton Gate.
metadata.content: Gallagher Prem: Louis Rees-Zammit scores two tries as Bristol Bears beat champions Northampton Saints | Rugby Union News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Gallagher Prem: Louis Rees-Zammit scores two tries as Bristol Bears beat champions Northampton Saints Bristol lay down a marker as they beat Gallagher Prem champions Northampton 41-26 with Louis Rees-Zammit scoring twice; in an abject performance Harlequins lose 48-0 to Gloucester; Leicester beat Newcastle 24-19 Saturday 3 October 2026 23:21, UK Image: Bristol Bears' Louis Rees-Zammit celebrates scoring a try during the Gallagher PREM match at Ashton Gate. Wales wing Louis Rees-Zammit played a starring role as Bristol posted an early-season statement win by beating Gallagher Prem champions Northampton 41-26 at Ashton Gate. Rees-Zammit followed up his two tries against opening opponents Sale Sharks with another double to put Bristol on the way to a bonus-point success. He also shone in defence as Bristol largely nullified Northampton's free-flowing game, while Harry Randall, Gabriel Oghre and Tom Jordan added further Bristol tries, and there was also a penalty try, with James Williams kicking three conversions and a penalty. messages.text: Keane: Bellingham can become one of greatest players ever

metadata.summary: England and Real Madrid star Jude Bellingham can become one of the world's greatest ever players, according to Sky Sports pundit Roy Keane.
metadata.content: Jude Bellingham: England and Real Madrid star tipped for greatness after Croatia thrashing by Roy Keane | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Jude Bellingham: England and Real Madrid star tipped for greatness after Croatia thrashing by Roy Keane England inflicted Croatia's biggest defeat in a 7-0 hammering in the Nations League with Jude Bellingham scoring one goal and setting up three more in a complete performance from the Real Madrid star who continues to shine for the Three Lions after his World Cup heroics Saturday 3 October 2026 20:27, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Thomas Tuchel praised England's 'dangerous' front four after the thrashing of Croatia England and Real Madrid star Jude Bellingham can become one of the world's greatest ever players, according to Sky Sports pundit Roy Keane. The 23-year-old scored one goal and set up three more as England inflicted Croatia's biggest defeat in a 7-0 hammering in front of a reduced crowd in Rijeka in the Nations League. Bellingham was England's standout player at the World Cup and has become the focal point of Thomas Tuchel's side, registering 13 goal involvements in his last 11 games since the start of the tournament.
